nodes.description: IERC20 token contract reference used for all token movements of the vault.
Public counter of tokens seeded by the owner to pay unlocking rewards.
Private accounting of all currently locked principal.
Private pause flag gating new locks (0 = active, 1 = paused).
Mapping address => Lock{user, amount, unlockTime} holding each user's lock record.
Private owner address controlled through Ownable and onlyOwner.
External whenNotPaused entry creating a 30 day lock for msg.sender and pulling tokens via transferFrom.
External entry releasing the caller's lock plus 40% rewards after the unlock time, decrementing pool and transferring tokens.
Internal pure helper computing (_amount * 40) / 100.
onlyOwner function pulling tokens from the owner and increasing rewardsPool.
onlyOwner function draining the entire balance of an arbitrary token held by the vault to the owner.
Caller-controlled address used to key locks, authorize owner checks and receive transfers.
Miner/validator-influenceable time source used to derive and enforce unlock times.
External call to the ERC20 transferFrom of GasifyVaultAddress; its success is not checked.
External call to the ERC20 transfer of GasifyVaultAddress; its success is not checked and it hands control to an arbitrary token contract.
Arithmetic on rewards and locked balances (multiplication/division in calculateRewards and subtractions of rewardsPool and totalLockedBalance).
Amount argument supplied by the caller to lock(), calculateRewards() and seedRewards().
Address argument of the getLockedTokens() view function.
Arbitrary token address argument of the owner-only withdrawLockedToken().
New owner address argument of transferOwnership().
Local holding block.timestamp + 30 days when a lock is created.
Local reward amount computed by calculateRewards and subtracted from rewardsPool.
Local sum of principal plus rewards transferred out on unlock.
Local balance of an arbitrary token read in withdrawLockedToken before transfer.
Initializes GasifyVaultAddress, zeroes balances and pause flag, and sets the owner through Ownable.
Public view returning the stored _owner address.
onlyOwner function reassigning _owner to a non-zero address.
onlyOwner function setting _owner to address(0).
onlyOwner function setting _isPaused to 1 to block new locks.
onlyOwner function resetting _isPaused to 0.
Public view exposing the pause flag value.
Public view returning the locked amount for a given account.
Public view returning totalLockedBalance.

edges.reason: lock() keys the locks mapping and event with the caller-controlled msg.sender.
unlock() reads and clears locks[msg.sender] and sends the payout to that caller-chosen address.
seedRewards() pulls tokens from the owner identified by msg.sender.
withdrawLockedToken() can be reached only when msg.sender equals the owner checked by onlyOwner.
lock() derives _unlockTime from block.timestamp, making the lock period timestamp dependent.
unlock() gate require(locks[msg.sender].unlockTime <= block.timestamp) depends on miner-influenceable block.timestamp.
Event/timestamp emission context for rewards seeding; no time-sensitive branch is enforced.
lock() invokes the external ERC20 transferFrom on the configured token.
seedRewards() invokes the external ERC20 transferFrom on the configured token.
unlock() invokes the external ERC20 transfer for principal plus rewards.
withdrawLockedToken() invokes the external ERC20 transfer of an arbitrary token to the owner.
lock() increases totalLockedBalance by the locked amount.
lock() writes the caller's Lock struct into the locks mapping.
lock() is gated by the whenNotPaused modifier reading _isPaused.
unlock() zeroes the caller's locked amount in the locks mapping.
unlock() decrements totalLockedBalance by the released principal.
unlock() subtracts the computed reward from rewardsPool; an unseeded pool makes this underflow/revert.
unlock() calls calculateRewards to obtain the reward amount.
calculateRewards() performs the multiplication and division (_amount * 40) / 100.
unlock() performs pool subtraction and principal-plus-reward addition as arithmetic operations.
External token transfer inside unlock() hands control to an attacker-controlled token that could re-enter before completion.
transferFrom pulls control to an external token contract during lock() state transitions.
Arbitrary-token transfer in withdrawLockedToken() executes external code while draining balances.
The _amount parameter flows into lock() to size the transferred and recorded amount.
The _amount parameter flows into calculateRewards() where reward arithmetic is performed.
The _account parameter is used by getLockedTokens() to index the locks mapping.
The _tokenAddress parameter selects which arbitrary token withdrawLockedToken() drains.
The newOwner parameter becomes the new privileged _owner in transferOwnership().
The _unlockTime local, derived from block.timestamp, is persisted into the caller's Lock.
The _rewards local is subtracted from rewardsPool and added into the payout inside unlock().
The _totalValue local is the amount passed to the external transfer call in unlock().

normalization_plan.reason: The _amount parameter only exists to size the lock() transfer and Lock record, so it should be folded into the lock() function node.
The _account parameter is used solely as the lock lookup key in getLockedTokens() and should be folded into that function node.
The _tokenAddress parameter only selects the token drained by withdrawLockedToken() and should be folded into that function node.
The newOwner parameter only feeds the ownership reassignment in transferOwnership() and should be folded into that function node.
The _unlockTime local is produced and immediately stored by lock(), so it should be merged into the lock() function node.
The _rewards local is computed and consumed entirely inside unlock(), so it should be merged into the unlock() function node.
The _totalValue local is only the argument of the external transfer call in unlock() and should be folded into that unsafe operation node.
The _balance local is only the amount transferred by withdrawLockedToken() and should be folded into that function node.
